title: Prior Conduct Complaints: Reduction Schedule for Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** In a conduct-complaint dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the prior-complaint reduction counts the other conduct-complaint violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before the dispute, the disputed one not counted: 2 or more take off 2 points; exactly one takes off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

| Other conduct-complaint violations in the twelve months before the dispute | Prior-complaint reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting the others (hypothetical accounts)

| Conduct-complaint violations in the twelve months, the disputed one included | Others | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |
| 2 | 1 | 1 point |
| 3 | 2 | 2 points |

Only conduct-complaint violations are counted; a late-delivery or dropped-batch violation does not add to this count. A conduct complaint recorded fourteen months before the dispute lies outside the twelve months.
